changelog: Security: user roles are now scoped to customers (issue #21). Non-admin accounts are read-only and see only the endpoints belonging to the customers they are assigned to. Previously every account had full read/write access to every endpoint on the server, which made St0r unsafe to expose to individual clients in MSP deployments.

Users page: a read-only account can now be assigned to one or more customers. An account with no customer assigned sees nothing — scoping fails closed, so a newly created account never starts out with server-wide visibility.

Every mutating API endpoint now requires an administrator, enforced both per route and by a global write guard. Endpoint lists, status counters, activities, job logs, backup statistics, file browsing, downloads and storage usage are filtered to the caller's customers; server-wide pages (Logs, Settings, Servers, Replication, Disk Guard, client installers) are administrator-only.

The UI follows the same rules: read-only accounts no longer see admin-only navigation entries, write buttons, or client installers (which embed an endpoint's internet auth key), and admin-only pages redirect to the dashboard.
Fix: the admin-only user list no longer returns each account's TOTP seed.
